src: If you wish to transcend the limits of your flesh.
Reach me at the top of this tower.
All will be answered in time.
What's going on with this gun?
I gave this weapon to you to help you.
Do not tell me you wish not to have it?
I was worried you might not like it, seeing how I compelled you to it.
I shall take it back then.
Can you renew the machines in my body?
The person outside the tower is missing a friend.
Both she and her friend have passed my exam.
But only one of them wished to become a better human.
Whereas I sent the other one out to gather more people.
So that is who you were asking about before.
In the room above, with all my other improved children.
So you can slaughter her like my other children?
No, I shall not let you.
None of my children were helped by you.
Neither have you sworn service to me, or helped me in any form.
I fail to see why I should grant you this wish of yours.
As you have become my child, I shall grant you this wish.
She will wait for you outside the tower.
You did lessen the pain on one of my mistakes.
I shall grant you this wish, as repentance for my mistake, and reward for your good deed.
It is a place only few shall have access to.
Even though you have become one of my children, that place shall not be reached by you.
What with those things, that escaped from here?
Not everyone took my enhancement well.
They are part of my shameful past.
Yet they are my children I hold dearly.
But yes, they are the result of my earliest attempts.
It took me many tries to combine the machines of this place with the bodies of strong humans.
Though all the missteps on my way there do present my progress.
I hold them as dearly as all my other children.
Are those weird talking people also "improved"?
In the beginning, not everybody came to me freely.
And I required followers to do my bidding.
So I gave them a push.
It messed up their brains a bit.
But do not worry. They are otherwise fine.
Though you do appear to have taken issue with them.
Do not worry, I can make you even better than they were.
Let me enhance you beyond your human limitations.
Take in some machines. To make you better.
Let yourself become more like me.
If you ever change your mind, ask me again.
You have become almost perfect, my child.
Still, there appears to be an issue.
Your body does not accept me fully.
Over time it will return back to what it was. Mostly.
When that time comes, reach me once more.
Until then, you shall be a weapon of mine.
Use this, to aid us in our aspirations.
I made it so it may never leave you.
Even when the machines influence in your body wanes.
You have met them, have you not?
Do you not wish to join them?
Like what you did to me?
Yes. I brought you closer to the machines.
Made you stronger with their weapons.
And lowered some of your human weaknesses.
As I did with most who conquered this tower.
You have passed the exam, so I shall tell you.
This is the place where I gather my army to fight the Machine God.
I have taken over his factory, and am producing my own.
I cannot fight the machines with machines only.
You have come back, my child.
Do you wish to become strong?
Hey, did you talk to the Titan?
This probably used to be a bed.
What is that supposed to mean?
This machine looks like it's connected to the door.
Where am I supposed to find organic lubricant?
I don't need anything from this machine anymore.
And I don't want to fill more of my stuff in there.
This must have been valuable a long time ago.
There's some broken tools here. Nothing useful though.
Can't use anything from that stuff.
Does seem to be functional, but I don't know its purpose.
I don't know what that is.
Not sure what this is. But nothing I could use.
These boots belonged to Careen Tyler, a Founding Guardian of the Crystal City.
The brain of someone who killed himself accidentally by imagining himself dead.
A recording of his chain of thoughts was preserved, but later erased.
These clothes were found on the street, encircled by a silent, astonished crowd.
Witnesses spoke of a profound shedding of human shackles—of an old man freeing himself once more, unbound by cloth.
Flesh draped over metal, I guess.
We want it peaceful in there.
You wanted peace, but it's war you got. [Begin Combat.]
I carry my weapon wherever I want.
Guys inside are tense. If they see a weapon in your hand, they will shoot.
Good. Don't draw your weapon in there. Guys are tense.
Hey. Put that weapon away or you'll get killed.
Hey. Put your weapon away or you're gonna regret it.
Hey, you want to see my wares?
Where they go, the flesh grows.
Where the flesh grows, life blooms.
Do you believe in the Titans?
They will bring us to peace.
You should go to New Delphi, if you wish to learn more.
I heard that one of our holy items had been stolen recently.
But the Titans sent out a champion to retrieve it.
This proves that the will of the Titans is real.
We're just taking a break on our pilgrimage to New Delphi.
I used to believe that travelling would be exciting.
But it's quite boring out here.
I started this journey with my pet fleshworm.
But we had to eat it when we ran out of food in the desert.
I could give you another one.
No, thank you. I'm already full.
You're either very brave, or very stupid.
I'll keep an eye on you, but feel free to walk around.
It's not often that we get visitors here.
Are you a friend of the Titans?
Then you should overthink your next actions.
We are peaceful, but not defenseless.
I would see this as an opportunity to still come to your senses, then.
Explore the world, talk with people, talk with the Flesh, and then return to us.
I'll keep an eye on you, but feel free to walk around.
Please put your weapon away. This is a peaceful place.
Place a grenade in someone’s bag
Find a friend for the big guy
Decide about the fate of the Perished City
Get an engram of a Heptarch
Kill a Fleshrunner while being a worm
Overcome the spikes in the Temple Dungeon via throwing some meat
Survive all waves during the Virtual Combat Exercise
I ain't got time to bleed
Overcome the Perished City administration while not siding with a faction
Share at least four memories with the Seneschal
Have 5 or more characters puke at the same time
Defeat a boss on Hard Difficulty during a Permadeath run
Finish the pilgrimage and help with the missing heart
Get the eyes for the blind man
Use this to distract other characters and creatures.
Blocks damage if used in the correct moment.
